program: Wingless raw-input to representation to prediction to reasoning chain
question: Can Wingless learn a compact representation directly from raw byte records and use that learned representation to infer a compositional relation on exact operand pairs never observed during training, while exact raw-pair memorization fails?
hypothesis: From a frozen raw-byte corpus containing eight recurrent four-byte value motifs embedded in nonsemantic high-byte noise, an unsupervised top-frequency four-byte representation learner will recover all eight recurrent motifs. A factorized learner trained only on represented training observations will achieve at least 0.95 accuracy on sixteen held-out operand pairs and reconstruct the correct raw output motif at least 0.95 of the time, while an exact represented-pair lookup control will achieve at most 0.25 held-out accuracy.

prior_evidence.observation: On four fresh real-code holdouts, the 512-motif raw-byte representation had minimum coverage 0.36012885277106671, minimum covered top-1 gain 0.38054777185211969, minimum event reduction 0.37991362272161633, and maximum representation-minus-baseline bits-per-byte -0.38933721355583994.

scope_statement: This is a bounded mechanism-level reasoning integration gate. Passing does not establish open-domain reasoning or LLM-class competence; it establishes that the raw representation stage can feed a learned compositional inference stage without tokenization or external-model inference.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, or live-interface authority

raw_benchmark.record_encoding: two raw four-byte operand motifs and one raw four-byte target motif embedded in deterministic nonsemantic bytes from range 192..255; benchmark record boundaries are supplied as sample boundaries only
raw_benchmark.motif_construction: eight distinct fixed raw motifs whose lexicographic order defines representation IDs 0..7; motif bytes are below 192 and noise bytes are 192..255
raw_benchmark.noise: deterministic LCG-derived bytes; no target information is encoded in noise
raw_benchmark.target_law: target_id = operand_a_id XOR operand_b_id; this law generates/scorers the benchmark only and is not called by prediction code

representation_learner.candidate: every contiguous four-byte window within each training record
representation_learner.selection: top eight by occurrence count descending, then lexicographic raw-byte key
representation_learner.representation_id: lexicographic rank of each selected four-byte key

reasoning_learner.factorized_state: for each of three representation-ID bit positions, a 2x2x2 integer count tensor over (operand_a_bit, operand_b_bit, target_bit), totaling 24 counters
reasoning_learner.update: increment target-bit counts using only decoded training representations and observed target representations
reasoning_learner.prediction: independently argmax each target bit from learned counts and reassemble one representation ID
reasoning_learner.target_law_visibility: prediction has no access to XOR or evaluator target code

lookup_control.prediction: argmax target ID for the exact pair with lowest-ID tie break
lookup_control.purpose: tests whether held-out success can be explained by memorizing exact represented operand pairs

raw_output.generation: map the predicted representation ID back to its learned selected four-byte motif
raw_output.metric: exact four-byte equality to the evaluator's target raw motif on held-out pairs

controls: The representation learner sees raw training bytes only and receives no motif labels, operand IDs, target law, or held-out bytes.
The factorized learner and exact-pair lookup receive the same represented training observations.
All sixteen exact held-out operand pairs are absent from training.
Every per-bit input combination required by the factorized learner occurs in represented training data for every bit position.
Evaluation is read-only; no held-out byte enters representation selection or reasoning updates.
No tokenizer, external model, network access, gradient optimizer, target-law call in prediction, capacity growth, or post-result tuning is permitted.
validity_criteria: Exact parent and North Star identities match.
Raw benchmark construction, train/holdout rule, repetitions, noise generator, representation capacity, and tie breaks match this preregistration.
The representation learner scans raw bytes and is not seeded with the evaluator's eight motif identities.
The factorized learner sees only learned representation IDs plus observed training target IDs; prediction does not call the target law.
The exact-pair lookup receives the same represented training examples.
All metrics are finite and full Go regression passes before the probe.
No external model, tokenizer, network call, capacity growth, threshold change, or adaptive evaluation occurs.

classification_rules.supported: All validity criteria and all eighteen frozen metric thresholds pass.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and factorized held-out accuracy exceeds lookup accuracy, but at least one representation recovery, 0.95 reasoning, or raw-output threshold fails.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but factorized held-out accuracy does not exceed lookup accuracy, or representation discovery fails to support compositional generalization.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents complete frozen training/evaluation.
classification_rules.invalid: Any provenance, construction, leakage, target-law isolation, deterministic-state, capacity, or qualification criterion fails.

stop_conditions: Stop invalid before scientific execution on parent, North Star, build, or frozen-package drift.
After output begins, complete the full frozen train/heldout matrix unless infrastructure prevents it.
Do not change motif construction, noise, split, capacity, factorization, lookup control, thresholds, or classification after observing output.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: No benchmark, representation, reasoning, control, metric, threshold, or interpretation may change after any primary output is observed under this experiment identifier.
